name: run_task
description: Ask the existing dant coworker to perform work in its Ubuntu VM. Await the actual task result before claiming success.

name: task_list
description: List saved tasks in this conversation with their actual workId, title, status and completed/total step counts. Use this read-only list to identify the matching task before cancellation; never guess IDs. Listing never executes, restarts, cancels or completes work.

name: task_cancel
description: Cancel an existing task in this conversation by its exact workId when the human requests cancellation or the task is explicitly abandoned or superseded. Supports current acknowledged running/waiting work and saved continuing/waiting_user tasks; the application verifies execution ownership. Paused, failed, review, completed and unconfirmed records require Work progress review. Preserves cancelled history without completing, deleting or starting work. cancelRequested means stopping awaits confirmation; only cancelled:true confirms cancellation.

name: memory_write
description: Replace durable dant memory with concise updated notes.

name: send_message
description: Share requested text, progress, or a useful link in the same chat. Do not send ordinary speech transcripts.

name: react_message
description: Optionally react to a user message when it naturally fits. Use its actual messageId, a single emoji, or null to remove your reaction. Do not acknowledge every message.

name: credential_find
description: Find saved credential metadata. This never returns secret values.

name: credential_get
description: Read a saved credential only when needed for the current authorized work. Never repeat secret values in speech or chat.

name: credential_request
description: Ask the user to enter missing credentials through a secure form. Never ask them to dictate passwords.

name: credential_store
description: Save an authorized credential in the encrypted vault. Keep secret values out of chat, memory and skills.

name: skill_list
description: List dant-managed reusable skills and their enabled state.

name: skill_get
description: Read a dant-managed skill before using or updating it.

name: skill_save
description: Create or update a reusable skill in the VM workspace. Never include credentials. Saving does not mean its helper scripts were tested.

name: send_file
description: Deliver an existing completed file from the Ubuntu VM to the same chat.

name: schedule_list
description: List saved one-time and recurring tasks, their IDs, intended timezones, cron expressions, priorities and state.

name: schedule_save
description: Create or manage a scheduled task only when the human requests it. One-time tasks need an explicit ISO-offset at and IANA timeZone. Recurring tasks use a five-field cron expression and omit at. Priority high/normal/low orders waiting runs. Reuse id for updates; enabled:false pauses. Saving never executes work immediately.

at.description: For a one-time task: an explicit ISO 8601 instant with Z or a numeric UTC offset. Omit at for recurring tasks.

cron.description: A recurring five-field cron expression: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, such as 0 9 * * * for daily at 09:00. Null selects a one-time task.

priority.description: Priority for scheduled runs waiting to start; never interrupts work already running.

timeZone.description: The intended IANA timezone, such as Asia/Kuala_Lumpur. Recurring tasks default to the current settings timezone.

name: schedule_delete
description: Remove a requested scheduled task by id. Dispatched work is not stopped.

name: end_call
description: End this voice call when the user asks to hang up.
